meta.frames: mother frame: egg centre origin, x forward, z up (m); tail frame x_t = x + 0.3835

decisions.problem: Hatch: DexArm with tool needs R 117, scene bore D 227
decisions.decision: Keep bore D 250. The arm passes in one fixed pose (upper arm 70 deg, forearm 60 deg, film convention) with the print head tilted needle up by a second STS3215. Base underside at z -0.090 so the passage circle sits on the egg axis. Door: 6 silicone petals hinged at D 256, opened to 135 deg into the womb by a drawstring on an N20 motor, splash guard only.
decisions.risk: Community URDF mesh and an assumed J2 mapping; cables and the silicone line can stand proud of the links.
decisions.test: MDF ring D 250; pass the real arm with head and lines 20 times; print a 210 mm disc from both stations through the ring; feeler gauge the smallest gap.

decisions.problem: Waterline and buoyancy: mother 35 to 45 kg, tail 13 kg, rear bore at or under water
decisions.decision: Design waterline z -0.145 at the hatch. Mother 30.5 kg: round tray D 410 with 18 L gel and 1.5 kg trim ballast. Tail reshaped as a gourd (max D 466, centre 50 mm lower, bottom z -0.283, 600 long, 3 mm PETG), 15.6 kg with 1.4 kg trim ballast, floats level at the same height. Foam inside a dry hull adds no lift.
numbers: old slim tail lift at dock height
decisions.risk: Part masses are estimates (1 kg moves the mother 2.8 mm, the tail about 5 mm); tail GM 0.07 m is small; waves over 20 mm reach the hatch.
decisions.test: Float mother with water in the tray, ballast to z -0.145 +/-3 mm; float tail, heel 10 deg, match axis heights within 5 mm; dock and run the arm, log freeboard.

decisions.problem: Dock: magnet sets never face each other; about 5 N per pair
decisions.decision: 3 Zubax FG401MA electropermanent magnets at r 185 (90, 210, 330 deg) on nickel plated low carbon steel pads, all above water. Female recess in the mother: 37.5 deg half angle, 30 deep, D 310 to D 264. Tail collar 28 tall, 1 mm play. Lip seal on the collar tip, SORTA-Clear 18, 1.5 x 6 mm at 30 deg, mean D 257. Magnets switched on after the faces touch. 12 N42 pairs rejected: no electrical release (about 40 N m to turn the ring) and a 3.7 J snap.
decisions.risk: Rated hold is on polished iron at zero gap; plating, grit or a 0.1 mm step cut it, and the manual has no gap curve in numbers.
decisions.test: Pull test one magnet on a bonded pad at 0 and 0.2 mm shim, 50 cycles; dock in water at 2 kPa for 1 h, watch the lip and the pads.
sources: Hennessey 1982, Compliant part mating and minimum energy chamfer design, MIT MS thesis

decisions.problem: Canal height: canal low point 74 mm above the gel surface
decisions.decision: A Clear V5 chute on the canal bottom line at 20.8 deg, from 30 mm under the gel surface (x 0.077, z -0.154) to the canal low point (x 0.352, z -0.050). Outer form unchanged. Lower canal, raised gel and buoyancy alone rejected.
decisions.risk: Silicone on wet resin friction not measured; if the push falls short the arm must guide the tail end.
decisions.test: Pull a 1.7 kg silicone dummy up a 300 mm chute strip at 20.8 deg, wet with gel and dry.

decisions.problem: Print time: FX-Pro through 102 mm 14G, 1.2 bar, about 19 h
decisions.decision: Dragon Skin 10 NV, stepped needle (PVA 12G Luer body 95 mm + 14G tip 20 mm exposed), cartridge fixed in the tail with a 1.0 m x 4 mm line, 20 mm/s (15 mm/s fallback), cartridge drive 23E26S2504KG-250RS (750 N), Nordson 600 ml 1:1 cartridge.
numbers: 666 ml with waste; cartridge 630 ml usable
decisions.risk: Cartridge piston area and mixer drop unpublished; faster nozzle widens the yielded zone toward 5 diameters; baby must use 0.61 L or less or change cartridges at a cap layer.
decisions.test: Push DS10 NV through the full line at 15, 20, 25 mm/s, log current and output; print 2.5, 3, 4 mm gap coupons at 15 and 20 mm/s and section them.
sources: Smooth-On Dragon Skin 10 NV technical bulletin
Nordson EFD general purpose tips (gauge chart)
PVA G series dispense needles (12G ID 2.16, OD 2.77, Luer lock)
Nordson EFD side by side 2K cartridges
medmix MIXPAC Systems for Adhesives brochure (hosted by Ellsworth)
Grosskopf et al. 2018, Viscoplastic matrix materials for embedded 3D printing, ACS AMI, doi 10.1021/acsami.7b19818

decisions.problem: Belly: rise limited to pumped air, stop at 10 L
decisions.decision: 5 concentric elliptical pleats, pitch 45, depth 14 at the sides and 9 at the ends, 2 mm SORTA-Clear 18, zone 0.29 m2 above z 0.164 and aft of x -0.30. Stop: 24 clear 0.5 mm nylon meridian cords cast in the skin, cut to the 10 L meridian. Pump inlet through a snorkel to outside air.
decisions.risk: Cords may show as faint lines; hoop direction not restrained; the rise mode is a model.
decisions.test: Pleat strip with 3 cords on a pressure box at 0.1 to 2 kPa; then the full belly at 2, 4, 6, 8.35, 10 L, measure crown rise.

decisions.problem: Rails and boom: 0.72 m of rail in a 588 mm tail
decisions.decision: 2 HIWIN MGNR12 x 500 mm, level, x_t -0.530 to -0.030, 2 MGN12H per rail at 130 mm span; boom plate 280 x 120 x 6 mm; stroke 370 mm; home base centre x_t -0.327; print stations x_t -0.040 and +0.040; NEMA 17 belt drive at the front end; cartridge off the boom.
numbers: 3.6 N m of 36 N m per block
arm top at home vs ceiling
decisions.risk: Two part layers need 0.1 mm boom repeatability; reach map from the URDF mesh.
decisions.test: Board mockup with a D 250 ring at x_t 0: home, passage, both stations 50 times, dial gauge at each station; print a 210 mm square in gel across the seam.
sources: HIWIN MG series catalog (hosted by Motion)
